metadata.description: A curated collection of .NET / C# skills for Claude Code — Roslyn analysis, refactoring, Avalonia DevTools, and more.

skills.name: roslyn-mcp
skills.description: 41 Roslyn-powered tools for C# code navigation, refactoring, code generation, and syntax conversion. Compiler-accurate symbol lookup, find references, go to definition, rename, extract method, convert to async, and more.

skills.name: ilspy-mcp
skills.description: 8 tools for decompiling and analyzing compiled .NET assemblies (DLLs). Inspect NuGet packages, framework libraries, and third-party DLLs without source code.

skills.name: avalonia-devtools
skills.description: 16 tools for connecting to running Avalonia applications to inspect visual trees, capture screenshots, modify properties, send input events, and iterate on XAML layouts. Requires an Avalonia Accelerate license key.

skills.name: avalonia-buildtools
skills.description: 5 tools and 4 prompts for accessing Avalonia documentation, API references, expert development rules, and migration guidance via a remote MCP server. Free — no license key or installation required.

skills.name: dotnet-wsl
skills.description: Ensures dotnet commands work correctly in WSL by routing them through the Windows dotnet.exe binary. Prevents NuGet fallback folder and SDK resolution failures on Windows-mounted drives.

skills.name: unit-tests
skills.description: Guided workflow for creating verified unit tests with a strict red/green cycle. One test per behavior, each verified to fail before implementation and pass after.

plugins.name: dotnet-skills
plugins.description: Roslyn-powered C# code analysis, refactoring, generation, and conversion skills, ILSpy assembly decompilation, and Avalonia DevTools UI inspection for Claude Code. Auto-installs required dotnet tools.
